Sum of two-digit numbers divisible by 3: Class 10 board exam ka ye AP question dekh ke dar lagta hai? Step by step, from the question to the answer.

• On a 1 to 99 chart: first term a = 12 (10 and 11 aren't multiples of 3), d = 3, last term l = 99
• Board method: 99 = 12 + (n − 1) × 3, so n = 30
• S = 30/2 × (12 + 99) = 15 × 111 = 1665
